title: seams show --json, with no id
description: The register: every registered seam with its characteristics, gaps first when a status file rates them.

top.description: The highest rung the seam can reach, whether or not it is rated: 5 when its sides deploy together (deploysIndependently is false), since a deploy gate has nothing to guard; 6 when they deploy apart, or that isn't recorded. Given by seams show --json for every seam, in the register and for a single seam; seams add and seams update --json, which also emit seam/v1, do not give it. A rung above it is shown as the status file gives it.

kind.description: The kind in the seam's id.

crossesOut.description: Whether the seam crosses out of the system: a party is external, or its audience is public.
